description: This file defines the RestResourceConfig class, a Drupal configuration entity for REST resource settings, including methods for managing plugin dependencies, supported formats, authentication, and granularity.

classes.name: RestResourceConfig
classes.description: A Drupal configuration entity class for REST resource configurations, managing plugin dependencies, supported methods, formats, authentication, and dependencies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RestResourceConfig object, converting the id to plugin_id format if necessary.

methods.name: getResourcePluginManager
methods.description: Retrieves the REST plugin manager service, caching it in the object.

methods.name: getResourcePlugin
methods.description: Returns the resource plugin instance associated with this configuration.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Returns supported HTTP methods based on the granularity setting.

methods.name: getMethodsForMethodGranularity
methods.description: Retrieves supported HTTP methods when granularity is method-specific.

methods.name: getAuthenticationProviders
methods.description: Returns supported authentication providers for a given method.

methods.name: getAuthenticationProvidersForMethodGranularity
methods.description: Retrieves supported authentication providers for a specific method.

methods.name: getFormats
methods.description: Returns supported response formats for a given method.

methods.name: getFormatsForMethodGranularity
methods.description: Retrieves supported formats for a specific method.

methods.name: getPluginCollections
methods.description: Returns plugin collections, specifically the resource plugin collection.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates and adds dependencies for the configuration entity.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles removal of dependencies, potentially deleting the entity if dependencies are unresolved.

methods.name: getRestResourceDependencies
methods.description: Retrieves the dependencies related to the REST resource.

methods.name: normalizeRestMethod
methods.description: Normalizes HTTP method strings to uppercase.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Rebuilds routing after saving the entity.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Rebuilds routing after deleting the entity.
